notes.title: Update 0.08.016 - Gameplay changes and improvements
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/830a60c641ca001077dad286dfeaf768d4bcfdd2.png[/img]

Hello everybody.

So there is another nice update. This time is focused on overhaul of items and their management. First big change is great overhaul of items' weight so they are now more real. Another big change is water management. Now you'll need containers to carry water so you'll need to craft bucket or obtain bottles in postapo anomaly first. Due to future plans, we decided to remove damaging items when craft fails. However, every action now damages related tool so don't forget to watch over them or you'll destroy and lose them entirely. You can now anytime repair any damage on them for free (this will change over time). And, as usual, many small things and issue fixes.

Here is complete changelog:

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]WATER - Any existing water (water in the bucket) what you had in your inventory is converted to chemical element H2O. You can drink and use it for production, but cannot be dropped. Changes in the new game object (we did not want to delete your all the water so it can be used this way).
[*]WATER - Water cannot be collected by use of skill FORAGE when standing in water anymore.
[*]WATER - Water can now be collected via inventory and context over specific items (empty bottle or an empty bucket) - through action "filled with water." It is necessary to stand in the water!
[*]WATER - if you have more containers for water, it is possible to fulfill all batch action.
[*]WATER - Supplementing thirst accept the weight and type of item that serves as a beverage.
[*]GARDENING - Reduced time for removing crop fileds.
[*]GARDENING - Planted crops can no longer dry - applies only to the single player game mode
[*]ATOOL - It is no longer possible to activate the tool using shortcuts skillbars (losing that sense, as an active tool to define itself when it is placed in skillbars or is used as a weapon).
[*]ATOOL - Slot for the active tool (among skillbars) no longer used for possible drag items. It is used only for visual information about what is currently active tool for the design / implementation of the action.
[*]ATOOL - Currently used tool cannot be moved and is colored red.
[*]ATOOL - Active tool gets corect decay during use.
[*]DECAY - Resources are not damaged after failed crafting anymore.
[*]DECAY - Items are no more auto repaired after login.
[*]DECAY - It is necessary to watch over damaged tools, weapons, ..
[*]DECAY - Damage has been graphically shown only in case of damaged items (small indicator bar on the right side of the icon of the item that was previously pointed continuously).
[*]ITEMS - All items' weights overhaul
[*]ITEMS - Adapted drop and quality items (tier) correctly according to skill.
[*]ITEMS - A small chance to get higher tier items (than player should obtain based on skill)
[*]ITEMS - Corrected information in a chat about getting tier raw material (instead of quality)
[*]ITEMS - Items in inventory has now small icon (bottom left corner), representing TIER (applies for Tier 1 and above - Tier 0 has no icon).
[*]ITEMS - Tooltip now shows current TIER, below the icon for the item.
[*]ITEMS - Crude knife can be repaired.
[*]ITEMS - Tools can be repaired within the skillbars (RMB on item)
[*]ITEMS - The minimum weight for automatic transfer of new items to the A2-A was reduced to 0.5 kg (as default). You can adjust this value in gameplay section in settings (allowed is 0.1 to 2.0 kg).
[*]SETTINGS - In section "gameplay", it is possible to disable/enable fishing game - and go fishing original (legacy) mode. There are no bonuses in legacy fishing (however, they are not present in newer mode as well .. yet).
[*]TREES - Now it is possible to collect raw materials (branches, leaves, etc.) from fallen trees. However, resources are halved due to damage during tree fall.
[*]TREES - Fallen tree now generates a proper number of tree logs (depending on tree size).
[*]CHAT - Added information where the new item is inserted ("INVENTORY" or "A2-A STORAGE").
[*]MISC - Destroying shrubs have a better sound and animation.
[*]MISC - Removed Tier from Armors' names - all armors are now TIER 0 - higher TIERs are automatically produced based on skills.
[*]MISC - The default icon (placeholder) is no longer so expressive + contains information that it is a placeholder.

[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Empty bucket - it is possible to craft in furniture section (1x board and 2x nails) - you can fill it with water and create "Bucket of water".
[*]Bucket of water - if you drink water, or use it in manufacturing and other activities - you'll get empty bucket back.
[*]Empty bottle (can be found in postapo anomaly) can be filled with water to create "Water bottle".
[*]Water bottle - if you drink water, or use it in manufacturing and other activities - you'll get empty bottle back.
[*]Wine - if you drink it, you'll get empty bottle back.
[*]Bucket of water / Empty bucket / Water bottle / Empty bottle - They have their own 3D models and can be used as decoration.
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed small backend issue with the any fireplace.
[*]Fertilize and waterring now won't drop below 0% anymore
[*]Fixed issue with dragging items and pressing ESC.
[*]Fixed a minor problem with the interaction with the surrounding objects.
[*]Fixed some bad translations.
[*]Fixed issue when character window is opened - character skill are now updated in realtime.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/830a60c641ca001077dad286dfeaf768d4bcfdd2.png[/img]

Hello everybody.

So there is another nice update. This time is focused on overhaul of items and their management. First big change is great overhaul of items' weight so they are now more real. Another big change is water management. Now you'll need containers to carry water so you'll need to craft bucket or obtain bottles in postapo anomaly first. Due to future plans, we decided to remove damaging items when craft fails. However, every action now damages related tool so don't forget to watch over them or you'll destroy and lose them entirely. You can now anytime repair any damage on them for free (this will change over time). And, as usual, many small things and issue fixes.

Here is complete changelog:

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]WATER - Any existing water (water in the bucket) what you had in your inventory is converted to chemical element H2O. You can drink and use it for production, but cannot be dropped. Changes in the new game object (we did not want to delete your all the water so it can be used this way).
[*]WATER - Water cannot be collected by use of skill FORAGE when standing in water anymore.
[*]WATER - Water can now be collected via inventory and context over specific items (empty bottle or an empty bucket) - through action "filled with water." It is necessary to stand in the water!
[*]WATER - if you have more containers for water, it is possible to fulfill all batch action.
[*]WATER - Supplementing thirst accept the weight and type of item that serves as a beverage.
[*]GARDENING - Reduced time for removing crop fileds.
[*]GARDENING - Planted crops can no longer dry - applies only to the single player game mode
[*]ATOOL - It is no longer possible to activate the tool using shortcuts skillbars (losing that sense, as an active tool to define itself when it is placed in skillbars or is used as a weapon).
[*]ATOOL - Slot for the active tool (among skillbars) no longer used for possible drag items. It is used only for visual information about what is currently active tool for the design / implementation of the action.
[*]ATOOL - Currently used tool cannot be moved and is colored red.
[*]ATOOL - Active tool gets corect decay during use.
[*]DECAY - Resources are not damaged after failed crafting anymore.
[*]DECAY - Items are no more auto repaired after login.
[*]DECAY - It is necessary to watch over damaged tools, weapons, ..
[*]DECAY - Damage has been graphically shown only in case of damaged items (small indicator bar on the right side of the icon of the item that was previously pointed continuously).
[*]ITEMS - All items' weights overhaul
[*]ITEMS - Adapted drop and quality items (tier) correctly according to skill.
[*]ITEMS - A small chance to get higher tier items (than player should obtain based on skill)
[*]ITEMS - Corrected information in a chat about getting tier raw material (instead of quality)
[*]ITEMS - Items in inventory has now small icon (bottom left corner), representing TIER (applies for Tier 1 and above - Tier 0 has no icon).
[*]ITEMS - Tooltip now shows current TIER, below the icon for the item.
[*]ITEMS - Crude knife can be repaired.
[*]ITEMS - Tools can be repaired within the skillbars (RMB on item)
[*]ITEMS - The minimum weight for automatic transfer of new items to the A2-A was reduced to 0.5 kg (as default). You can adjust this value in gameplay section in settings (allowed is 0.1 to 2.0 kg).
[*]SETTINGS - In section "gameplay", it is possible to disable/enable fishing game - and go fishing original (legacy) mode. There are no bonuses in legacy fishing (however, they are not present in newer mode as well .. yet).
[*]TREES - Now it is possible to collect raw materials (branches, leaves, etc.) from fallen trees. However, resources are halved due to damage during tree fall.
[*]TREES - Fallen tree now generates a proper number of tree logs (depending on tree size).
[*]CHAT - Added information where the new item is inserted ("INVENTORY" or "A2-A STORAGE").
[*]MISC - Destroying shrubs have a better sound and animation.
[*]MISC - Removed Tier from Armors' names - all armors are now TIER 0 - higher TIERs are automatically produced based on skills.
[*]MISC - The default icon (placeholder) is no longer so expressive + contains information that it is a placeholder.

[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Empty bucket - it is possible to craft in furniture section (1x board and 2x nails) - you can fill it with water and create "Bucket of water".
[*]Bucket of water - if you drink water, or use it in manufacturing and other activities - you'll get empty bucket back.
[*]Empty bottle (can be found in postapo anomaly) can be filled with water to create "Water bottle".
[*]Water bottle - if you drink water, or use it in manufacturing and other activities - you'll get empty bottle back.
[*]Wine - if you drink it, you'll get empty bottle back.
[*]Bucket of water / Empty bucket / Water bottle / Empty bottle - They have their own 3D models and can be used as decoration.
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed small backend issue with the any fireplace.
[*]Fertilize and waterring now won't drop below 0% anymore
[*]Fixed issue with dragging items and pressing ESC.
[*]Fixed a minor problem with the interaction with the surrounding objects.
[*]Fixed some bad translations.
[*]Fixed issue when character window is opened - character skill are now updated in realtime.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.08.014 - Improved construction mode!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/20845b8ee3deb4cfaebd2786c75e3fc67d5ddb19.png[/img]

We have prepared for you another update.

Which includes major new changes in building mode.
These changes are not yet perfect, but they serve as a new basis for further improvements.

Now you can filter between building parts - which facilitates better orientation.
It is also possible during the planning delete, move or copy an already scheduled parts!
We created a new core snap system - its no longer too complex placing parts - but you are trying to connect themselves to the permitted snap points already built parts.
Also, construction not longer governed according to the player's position (height);)

The new system is not perfect, but hopefully make your job easier during the construction of his home in Novus Inceptio ːnipictoː.

Remember, you can now also already built components disassembled into raw materials!

[b]Mainly we apologize for it now that the majority of your homes look broken :( Due to great overhaul of building tool, there are expected issues with planning some building parts (already finished parts before this update). Because of added snapping system, already planned/constructed DOORS, STAIRS, SMALL WALLS and some FENCES will be most probably displayed inproperly. To fix this, you'll need to salvage placed parts first and place/craft them again.[/b]

Thank you for playing Novus Inceptio ːnipictoː!

[h1]Building mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]New main core for building mode.
[*]New snap system for building parts
[*]All building components have specific snap slots
[*]Possibility to REMOVE (only) planned parts in building mode.
[*]Possibility to COPY already planned / constructed (not finished) objects in building mode - no need to search the building parts in the UI.
[*]Possibility to PICK UP and MOVE already planned / constructed (not finished) objects in building tool.
[*]Door now properly fit in the door walls and opens / closes correctly.
[*]Building mode now works in day time so you can plan building even during nights.
[*]In the bottom bar of the selection of component parts you can click on the whole icons and not just on the "BUILD" button.
[*]Filtration building parts
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]CRAFT - The rope is now produced from Fibres instead of Threads.
[*]INTERACTION - Cattail no longer requires a specific iron knife to perform an action (GET Reeds), but any knife (even crude knife).
[*]INTERACTION - It is possible to dismantle (SALVAGE) already built and finished parts - this event destroys part and gives you materials back.
[/list]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]CRAFT - 9 new recipes for the production of seedlings (section FARMING)
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]CRAFT - Fixed problem with the recipe for creating raw iron ore from scrap metals.
[*]CRAFT - Fixed problem during producing a building parts where there was a production of another building part instead selected (we hope that the problem will not be deeper).
[*]CORE - Fixed camera settings in the main menu - should fix rare issue observable only on some specific hardware configurations.
[*]UI - Fixed problem with onmouse tooltip blink when mouse is over any inventory/skillbars item and tooltip hit game window edge.
[*]UI - Nails and planks now contains note in description that one raw piece produces more pieces!
[/list]
-------------
[h1]Hot fixs - unchanged version.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed wrong player collision on stairs.
[*]Fixed problem with recipes.
[*]Fixed problem with drop FPS
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.08.006
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/26/25539/thumb_620x2000/12983263_1118079958223239_6356498327377730081_o.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody, 
we apologize for the long delay since the last update.
But we had to undergo several gaming conference for the presentation of the game and also the establishment of trade and other useful contacts for further development of the game and the company.

These conferences and presentations brought us another very valuable insight into how the project directly to the customers (who have a game and we can tried to watch live reactions), as well as from other developers. For us it was very securities months and brought a lot of knowledge and experience that will help to continue to play.

Recent months have brought us to the awards as "Best Graphics" on Game Access 2016, where we won among the 40 participating projects. We've also got two nominations for "Czech Game of the Year 2015", unfortunately, here we did not turn the nomination, but even so it is very valuable awards from critics Czech gaming scene.

With peace of mind, we can now say that the business months ended and now we returns to only and only develop the game!

notes.title: Update 0.08.005
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

we are like to announce that there is another update inbound. There is actually nothing big but one nice feature and bunch of fixes.

At first, you are now able to select MAX items to craft when using "masscraft" feature. And there is solved issue with displaying recently learned blueprints.

And there is complete changelog as usual:

[h1]Gameplay updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added "MAX" button in craft window
[*]Disabled option to drop blueprint
[*]All the heavier items are automatically put into A2-A inventory (mainly logs and heavy items)
[*]Land Claim token - is now a new "building part" - now the deed paper is a resource for the completion of the land claim token
[*]Fireplace has a new crafting category "Smelt", instead of "RAW"
[*]Added autofill in building craft mode
[*]Added new recipe for fireplaces - reversed production of "raw iron ore" from "scrap metal"
[*]Stacks containing over 5 pieces now offers dropping whole stack instead of single item
[*]Removed option to pick up already manufactured building components. Now you need to finalize or destroy it
[*]Added info how to cancel repetitive action (like collection of leaves, ..)
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed locked craft screen when switching Craft modes (fireplace, anvil)
[*]Fixed issue with displaying learned recipes in Craft modes
[*]Fixed problem with music while game is loading
[*]Fixed multiplication dropped stacked items
[*]Corrected translation of some building components
[*]Fixed issue with removing picked and placed building component from inventory via Created tab in building mode
[*]Fixed issue with saving ingame time
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.08.001 - NEW Clean Single Player mode + Changing the basic game logic 2/2
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/317871298376472612/BCEC4AF6D999834F46F75B1BCFFECE5DA856ECA0/[/img]

New big update is up and there are many new features that we are glad to introduce now.

First of all, awaited [b]Single player[/b]. Game now allow you to chose local play that will [b]not need online connection anymore[/b]. All data are stored locally in this mode so don't forget to backup. Also, keep in mind that your singleplayer character will be never bonded any way with your online character or future MMO game mode. And finally, we are curious about your feedback for new mode so please check forum and share your ideas in new singleplayer sticky topic.

Another big change is related to crafting. Because the game became in some kind of blueprint hunting simulation, we decided to remove all common blueprints from the game and allow all players to use these without limitations. Advanced blueprints (mostly building parts) remain untouched. We hope this will help anyone in the beginning and enjoy exploration of the game instead of hunting for certain recipes. Also, we removed chests from towers. These contained knife for cases you lost it so we want to introduce new kind of knife which is available to craft without any tools. And another update is removing few recipes from your crafting menu. At the moment, you can cook by interaction with fire, also there are few items available on anvil. And last big thing is that you will no longer need to have active tool during crafting. When needed, it is enough that tool is available in belt. In this case fishing and farming are bit exotic and still need have proper tool active to perform related actions.

Last part of this patch announcement is related to [b]Steam trading Cards[/b]. You can notice these in game splash screen but if you are playing immediatelly after release, these are most probably not available yet. Cards were already submitted to Steam to release but it could take few days till it will be approved.

[b]And finally, we are leaving for Europe Casual Connect 2015 event in Amsterdam (Netherlands) right today and will be back next weekend. So we really want to apologize for delayed reactions on forums.[/b]

Update contains:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Singleplayer (offline) mode
[*]Steam trading cards! [b](We are still waiting for approval from the Valve)[/b]
[/list]

[h1]New Single Player mode![/h1]
[list]
[*]SP - Removed active internet connection requirement
[*]SP - Removed active steam connection requirement
[*]SP - All data are stored locally
[*]SP - Possibillity to play all arround the world with no lag
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new tool - "Crude Knife " - it is a knife from stone, branch and fiber available to craft without any other tool - for emergencies when you lose your starting knife ...
[*]Initial "Iron Knife" was changed "to Crude Knife" -> for new players
[*]Action " get branch " no longer requires a knife
[*]Removed chests with blueprints and knife from towers
[*]Basic campfire now won't dissapear after burning out
[*]SP and GHOST modes no more uses server time - game time will not change during your absence
[*]SP and GHOST modes day time changed from 60+60 minutes for day/night to 90+30 minutes
[*]Cooking is now available only through a burning campfire
[*]Added option to delete your character
[*]Map now supports dragging with mouse, scrolling with touching edges of screen remains untouched
[*]Tools required for crafting are now not required to be active. Now it is enough to have them available in belt. Active tool will be prefered for actions where more tools can be used and also is used as weapon. Fishing and farming still needs active tools to perform related actions.
[*]Moved some crafting recipes to interaction with Anvil, Campfire, Basic Campfire and Furnace placed on ground
[*]Removed blueprints for common items (these are now available to everyone from the beginning), advanced recipes remains untouched
[*]Craft menus now offer all available recipes in the game with except advanced blueprints that you still need to find and learn first.
[*]A2A now informs only about really learned blueprints
[*]Map is now enlighted all day long
[*]You can now destroy campfires.
[/list]

[h1]Issue Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed visual counting of collected materials from sources (trees, etc.)
[*]Fixed the history collected from sources of raw materials (trees, etc.) - for active game
[*]Fixed visual counting of collected materials from world sources (car, rock etc.) via "Forage" skill
[*]Fixed the history collected from world sources (car, rock etc.) via "Forage" skill - for active game
[*]Fixed visual counting of collected materials and history in current active anomaly
[*]Fixed visual shadows bugs during the transition time
[*]Fixed lags when opening crafting windows after learning any new blueprint
[*]Fixed lags when opening building mode
[*]Fixed lags when switching filters in building mode
[/list]

---------------------
[h1]0.08.002 - fast hotfix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed - SP - the problem with the destruction of shrubs
[*]Fixed - SP - System chat no longer claim that you're on the EU server
[/list]

notes.notes:

First, we would like to invite you to the [b]Casual Connect in Amsterdam 16-18 February 2016[/b], where we can meet in person and it is also possible to obtain a unique presskit game compilation!

More information about CC2016 can be found below.
------------------------------------

We decided to divide new update into [b]two phases[/b]. So you don't have to wait for the new changes to the detriment of the upcoming single-player mode (without an Internet connection).

So we [b]split the update[/b], and currently there is a new version of the major changes in inventory and production improvements + performance improvements.

[b]In less than a week will be have completed for you the second part of the update[/b], and it doesn't make a sense to wait for it (when the first portion is completed).
The second part will bring further adjustments in production (the logic of learning, the allocation of production objects, improve logic of interaction) and especially the promised Single player (without an Internet connection!).

Some changes you will experience might came strange, but with the second part of the update, everything will became clear (for example, not stacking blueprints etc.) - [b]we thank you for your patience and support.[/b]

[b]All of these changes open new ways for future updates and issue fixes. For example tweaking UI with filtering and searching will require changing internal logic before making visible updates, but now, we are (more than) one step closer.[/b]

http://europe.casualconnect.org/index.html

Where you can visit and meet in person at booth number 904!
http://europe.casualconnect.org/planning/cc-amsterdam-2016-sponsors.png


Actual changes of this first part of the update can be found as usual changelist:

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated project to Unity 5.3.2p2 version
[*]Added option to settings - video - HDR on / off
[*]Reduced memory consumption according to the system
[*]Increased performance by 10-20 FPS according to the system and hardware (best result is on NORMAL settings)
[/list]

[h1]Inventory changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Remade Inventory behavior and items' logic (following changes will help fix some issues, improve performance and allow further changes in the future)
[*]Some items are now grouped into packages that will not expand (mainly raw materials and some craft products)
[*]The quality of raw materials now appear as "TIER" (0QL to 49QL is now TIER 0, 50QL to 99QL is now TIER 1, etc.).
[*]Grouped items are grouped according to UID, TIER and type of material. They can develop packages for Grass TIER1 or TIER2. And branches Tier1 - Material willow / spruce etc.
[*]Products such as tools, weapons, etc. are presented as separate items and also have their QL. These items are not grouped.
[*]In some cases it's possible that you will lose some items after applying this update. Alternatively, most of them will overlap other items. (We are sorry for this, but this was big change in internal structures and it is better than a complete wipe).
[*]An opportunity to organize the contents of the container (inventory, A2-2 etc.) with the new button.
[/list]

[h1]Crafting changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rebuilded logic of the crafting:
[*]Possibility to produce multiple pieces at once
[*]Automatic pre-filling materials
[*]Reduced crafting time based on player skill from 5s to 0.5s (skill < 5 time = 5s - skill > 50 time = 0.5s)
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Translated all building parts.
[*]Fixed flashing tree material.
[*]Added destroy action on both campfires.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a system translation "#MALTA" in the crafting process
[*]Fixed system translation "#BRICK_PACK" in the crafting process
[*]Fixed system translation "#LEATHER_PACK" in the crafting process
[*]Fixed system translation "#CLOTH_PACK" in the crafting process
[*]Fixed crash with AMD and NVIDIA on Windows
[*]Fixed flickering/texture swapping UI issues
[*]Fixed crash when moving larger package items into another container.
[/list]

notes.title: As time went and current update status
notes.notes:
In advance we want to thank you for patience and say sorry for delay in current update. Our previously expected release date wasn't fulfilled because we stacked more changes over another ones (more details below) because splitting them will cause game logic to fall apart.

[h1]At first small recap of our early access[/h1]

[b]October:[/b] Very difficult month dedicated to fixing most of the critical issues and community communication.

[b]November:[/b] Situation after release calmed a bit, there was a timeframe for bigger update with new large anomaly that contains more complex interactions and also new content pack.

[b]December:[/b] Mostly dedicated to paperwork and solving organization issues. Also first steps in preparations to fulltime development in next months. We also went through issues reports and players‘ feedback more deeply. Thanks to this we have found few things that are needed to be added, replaced, removed or just reworked to be working. And because tweaking single one affected another, we weren’t able finish update in time.

[b]January:[/b]  Whole month was/is dedicated to finishing scheduled work. Estimated delivery is now during next two weeks (currently we are finishing the final changes and perform internal tests).

[h1]So, what exactly will this update changes?[/h1]

[olist]
 [*]Pure single player mode that will require no internet access for play. (Detailed description will be shipped with update.)
 [*]Major focus is on another performance optimalizations. Actually we were able to achieve about 10-20 FPS against current version.
 [*]Reworking of inventory and item management. Because there is no need of using detailed quality for every single item, we decided to remove quality of natural resources and stack them by tier. However quality is still in game and used for crafting (and fighting in future), tier is just grouped average value. This allow us to decrease ammount of stored data and increase performance of inventory and crafting. Also, inventories are now much easier to understand and use because there will be no need for opening stacks. In addition, this should fix some issues with missing items in inventory.
 [*]Crafting is currently very complex and one of main attractions of the game. While we want to keep this complexity, we also want to ease its usage. So, we have just added possibility to craft more items in a row and also autofilling required items in craft window.
 [*]Crafting menu was too complex and because many items requires some specific environment (like fire for cooking), we decided to remove these recipes from craft menu and move them as context on these environmental objects.
 [*]Based on previous change, there is also interaction update while using tools. You do not need to have required tool active while crafting, it‘s enough to have it deployed on your belt (skillbars). This should save you same more clicks during crafting.
 [*]Because game was recently played like ‘find a chest’ simulator due to hunt for blueprints, we decided to remove all basic blueprints from the game and allow players to use all of them by default. Also, these recipes are now automatically unlocked with enough skill. Thanks to this, you will never again meet situation when you are missing blueprint for required part for already known and more advanced blueprint. Rare blueprints (cloning station, token, some building parts) will be still random dropped in chests.
 [*]Many minor issue fixes and gameplay tweaks.
[/olist]

All of these changes open new ways for future updates and issue fixes. For example tweaking UI with filtering and searching will require changing internal logic before making visible updates, but now, we are (more than) one step closer.

Thank you for undestanding and patience in waiting for update.

We are still working. Hard.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=610501039&insideModal=0

notes.title: Update 0.06.014 - Critical unplanned hotfix
notes.notes:
This update is a bit unplaned but crucial. Due to changing year to 2016, there is some issue with detection of time that causes instant decay and destruction many items. We decided to turn off all time decay for all items now. There also few minor updates that was inevitable to remove for this update. For example, there are few new character animations and also engine update that should fix issues in Windows 10.

Planned more complex update will be shipped during next few days.

[b]To all who have lost any items due 2K16 problem, we apologize.[/b]
Thank you for your understanding.

[h1]Critical[/h1]
[list]
[*]Interrupted time decay on all items - due to issues with disappearance of items after the transition to the new year 2016.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Repaired and added character animations for moving sideways and turning - Incomplete for all movements. With regard to the necessary release this update now (This part can not be turned off for this update).
[/list]

[h1]Technical[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance Optimization next phase.
[*]Repair and optimization of some objects materials.
[*]Repair and optimize the dynamic font.
[*]Optimisation for Windows 10 OS - Phase 1 for tests.
[*]Optimization problems D3D12 - Phase 1 for tests.
[*]D3D12: Fixed a crash when using compute buffers.
[*]D3D: Mouse coordinates no longer go out of bounds when upscaling to desktop resolution.
[*]D3D: Fixed broken positioning of render when upscaling to native desktop resolution.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.06.008-10 Bigger content update +hotfix
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.novus-inceptio.eu/public/updates/006008/2015-11-21_00008.jpg[/img]
We want gladly introduce our first bigger content pack. This update contains two big things followed with several smaller ones.

First one is about new [b]hi tech blueprints[/b]. You can drop them in anomalies as usual. These blueprints are focused on creating items that will help you with doing NI your second home. You will be now able to craft your own cloning machine and place it within your home(s). Second big item is new deed token. You are now able to create token that will work as your 'home mark'. This token is visible on map, it's considered as safe place and you will be able to sell items near it. Yes, you read this well. You will be now able to sell things. Let's say to NPC. There is actually nothing you can do with your obtained currency (let's wait few more updates), but at least you can get rid of items you do not need at all.

notes.title: [October 22, 2015] Update 0.06.007 - first big RAM performance
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce first big performance update.

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced memory consumption by [b]1-2 GB[/b] according to the system.
[/list]

There are several changes in internal logic like lowering number of objects hold in memory, their complexity or quality. Most of them are only internal changes that doesn't affect gameplay in any way. 

But main change is removing prebuffered data for anomalies. [b]This means you can experience small lags when entering anomalies[/b].

notes.title: [October 13, 2015] Update 0.06.004
notes.notes:
During the last days we went through all the reports and deficiencies.
Unfortunately, we lost many days of solution updates Unity engine, which should fix these things:
[list]
[*]D3D12: Fixed a crash when using compute buffers.
[*]D3D: Mouse coordinates no longer go out of bounds when upscaling to desktop resolution.
[*]D3D: Fixed broken positioning of render when upscaling to native desktop resolution.
[/list]

But the current update Unity engine is in very poor condition and we were forced to restore the backup. So the above corrections could not be implemented - thank you for your understanding and hopefully soon will be.

But we have uploaded an update which includes the following changes: 

[h1]Major[/h1]
[list]
[*]Auto pickup resources (repeat operation till stamina or items run out) - first step
[*]Disable repair on not damaged items (repair available if decay >5%)
[*]Increase the quality of raw material Obtained using the "GET" actions (from trees etc.).
[*]Events eat already not consumes stamina but rather to complement it.
[*]A smaller increase in performance.
[/list]

[h1]Minor[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added missing translations - game actions etc.
[*]Correction of translation - options.
[*]Correction of translation - launcher.
[*]Removing unnecessary shadows from the lights of the tower.
[*]FPS mode - finally you can see the character head shadow.
[*]Show game version even when mouse mode is active - for better debuging reports.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]No longer allowed to place items on ground in anomalies.
[*]Anvil - the correct name of the event for placement on the ground.
[*]Removed all incomplete blueprints called "#ERROR".
[/list]

It's not too much, but we are already preparing next update containing also little new content.
But priority still holds bugs and preparing new single player version which will not require active online connection.
